name: When is the best time to consider smart home features during a whole-home remodel or addition?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to consider smart home features during a whole-home remodel or addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The optimal time to consider smart home features is during the initial design phase of a whole-home remodel or addition. This allows for proper planning of wiring infrastructure, power requirements, and strategic placement of devices, preventing costly retrofits later. Integrating these decisions into our managed design-build process ensures that smart technology is not just added, but thoughtfully woven into the fabric of your home, aligning with structural elements and aesthetic goals. This approach supports a cohesive outcome where functionality, beauty, and value are harmonized from concept to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best time to integrate smart home features is during the initial design phase of a remodel or addition, allowing for proper infrastructure planning and seamless integration into the home's overall design.
